title: SysAdmin Manual Backup Trigger Permitted
description: Verify that an authorized System Administrator (SysAdmin) is permitted to trigger an immediate manual database backup.
pre_conditions: SysAdmin user 'sysadmin_01' is authenticated; database service is operational and ready for dump.
execution_steps: 3. Verify BADMS authorizes the request and initiates database state dump.
expected_outcome: Manual backup request is accepted; backup execution begins; timestamp and start status recorded.
failure_guarantee: If manual backup fails to start, system state remains unchanged and failure alert is triggered to SysAdmin.

title: Super Admin Manual Backup Trigger Permitted
description: Verify that an authorized Super Admin is permitted to trigger an immediate manual database backup.
pre_conditions: Super Admin user 'superadmin_01' is authenticated; target database dataset is accessible.
execution_steps: 3. Verify BADMS evaluates authorization and triggers backup operation.
expected_outcome: Manual backup request is authorized; database state dump begins; Success status recorded upon completion.
failure_guarantee: Unauthorized state modification is prevented; target database remains in a consistent state.

title: Regular User Manual Backup Trigger Prohibited
description: Verify that a regular User (Faculty/Student/Staff) is prohibited from triggering a manual database backup.
pre_conditions: Regular user 'user_faculty_01' is authenticated with role 'User'.
execution_steps: 2. Attempt to trigger manual backup for 'production_core_db'.
expected_outcome: Manual backup request is denied with 403 Forbidden; no backup job is spawned; security audit log records unauthorized attempt.
failure_guarantee: No database state dump or backup process is created; database integrity and resources remain undisturbed.

title: Department Head Manual Backup Trigger Prohibited
description: Verify that a Department Head (HoD) without SysAdmin/Super Admin privileges is prohibited from triggering a manual backup.
pre_conditions: HoD user 'hod_cs_01' is authenticated; role is strictly 'HoD'.
execution_steps: 2. Submit request to trigger manual backup for 'cs_dept_db'.
expected_outcome: Request is denied due to lack of manual backup authority; audit log records unauthorized access attempt.
failure_guarantee: Database state dump is not triggered; system operational boundaries are preserved.

title: Respective HoD Decision on Departmental Secure Archival Permitted
description: Verify that the HoD of the requester's department is permitted to approve or reject a secure archival request.
pre_conditions: Secure archival request 'REQ-ARCH-101' submitted by user in 'Computer Science' department; status is 'Submitted'.
execution_steps: 2. Access secure archival request 'REQ-ARCH-101' originating from Computer Science.
expected_outcome: Approval is accepted; request status transitions from 'Submitted' to 'HoD-Approved'; request is routed to SysAdmin.
failure_guarantee: If approval recording encounters an error, request status remains 'Submitted' and does not route to SysAdmin.

title: Cross-Department HoD Secure Archival Decision Prohibited
description: Verify that an HoD from a different department is prohibited from deciding a secure archival request outside their department.
pre_conditions: Secure archival request 'REQ-ARCH-102' submitted by requester in 'Mechanical Engineering' department; status is 'Submitted'.
execution_steps: 2. Attempt to approve or reject request 'REQ-ARCH-102' belonging to Mechanical Engineering.
expected_outcome: Decision is rejected with departmental scope violation error; request 'REQ-ARCH-102' remains in 'Submitted' state.
failure_guarantee: Request routing and status are unmodified; unauthorized departmental crossover is prevented.

title: Non-HoD Actor Secure Archival Decision Prohibited
description: Verify that non-HoD actors (such as SysAdmin or regular User) are prohibited from approving or rejecting secure archival requests.
pre_conditions: Secure archival request 'REQ-ARCH-103' in 'Submitted' state awaiting HoD approval.
execution_steps: 2. Attempt to record HoD approval decision on request 'REQ-ARCH-103'.
expected_outcome: Action is denied; SysAdmin cannot bypass or substitute for respective HoD approval; request status remains 'Submitted'.
failure_guarantee: Request remains in 'Submitted' state awaiting respective HoD action; no routing to classification stage occurs.

title: IT Security Encryption Configuration for Sensitive Data Permitted
description: Verify that an authorized IT Security Team member is permitted to configure encryption for data authoritatively classified as Sensitive.
pre_conditions: Secure archival request 'REQ-ARCH-104' authoritatively classified as Sensitive by SysAdmin and routed to IT Security.
execution_steps: 3. Configure encryption using AES-256 cipher parameters and submit.
expected_outcome: Encryption configuration is accepted; BADMS initiates creation of AES-256 encrypted archive.
failure_guarantee: Unencrypted data is never written to long-term storage if encryption configuration fails.

title: SysAdmin Encryption Configuration Prohibited
description: Verify that a SysAdmin is prohibited from configuring encryption parameters for Sensitive archival requests.
pre_conditions: Secure archival request 'REQ-ARCH-105' classified as Sensitive and routed to IT Security.
execution_steps: 2. Attempt to configure encryption settings on Sensitive archival request 'REQ-ARCH-105'.
expected_outcome: Configuration attempt is denied with authorization error; encryption configuration interface is restricted to IT Security.
failure_guarantee: Separation of duties is maintained; encryption parameters remain unconfigured until IT Security acts.

title: Regular User Encryption Configuration Prohibited
description: Verify that a regular User is prohibited from configuring encryption parameters for Sensitive data.
pre_conditions: Archival request 'REQ-ARCH-106' classified Sensitive pending encryption configuration.
execution_steps: 2. Attempt to invoke encryption configuration endpoint on 'REQ-ARCH-106'.
expected_outcome: HTTP 403 Forbidden error returned; unauthorized user blocked from encryption configuration.
failure_guarantee: Encryption parameters are unmodified; security configuration integrity is protected.

title: SysAdmin Authoritative Classification After HoD Approval Permitted
description: Verify that an authorized SysAdmin is permitted to assign authoritative classification (Critical, Sensitive, Routine, Archival) to an HoD-approved request.
pre_conditions: Secure archival request 'REQ-ARCH-107' approved by respective HoD; routed to SysAdmin.
expected_outcome: Authoritative classification 'Sensitive' is saved; request is routed to IT Security for encryption configuration.
failure_guarantee: If classification assignment fails, request remains in HoD-approved queue without downstream processing.

title: Non-SysAdmin Authoritative Classification Assignment Prohibited
description: Verify that non-SysAdmin actors (e.g. HoD or User) are prohibited from assigning authoritative classification.
pre_conditions: Secure archival request 'REQ-ARCH-108' has HoD approval recorded.
execution_steps: 2. Attempt to assign authoritative classification 'Critical' to 'REQ-ARCH-108'.
3. Verify system enforces SysAdmin-only authorization constraint.
expected_outcome: Action is denied with 403 Forbidden; authoritative classification can only be assigned by SysAdmin.
failure_guarantee: Request authoritative classification remains unassigned; security and retention policies are not misapplied.

title: SysAdmin Classification Prior to HoD Approval Prohibited
description: Verify that SysAdmin cannot assign authoritative classification to a request that has not yet received HoD approval.
pre_conditions: Secure archival request 'REQ-ARCH-109' is in 'Submitted' state; HoD has not yet approved.
execution_steps: 2. Attempt to assign authoritative classification to unapproved request 'REQ-ARCH-109'.
expected_outcome: Operation rejected with state error; authoritative classification is only permitted after HoD approval.
failure_guarantee: Request remains in 'Submitted' state; HoD approval prerequisite cannot be bypassed.

title: Authoritative Classification Value Boundary and Rejection
description: Verify that authoritative classification accepts exactly the four valid domain values (Critical, Sensitive, Routine, Archival) and rejects any undefined value.
pre_conditions: Secure archival request 'REQ-ARCH-110' is approved by HoD and ready for classification.
execution_steps: 2. Attempt to set classification to 'Confidential' on 'REQ-ARCH-110'.
4. Submit valid classification 'Archival' and verify acceptance.
expected_outcome: Invalid value 'Confidential' is rejected with validation error; valid value 'Archival' is successfully applied.
failure_guarantee: Data classification domain remains strictly constrained to {Critical, Sensitive, Routine, Archival}.

title: Sensitive Restoration Permitted Following SysAdmin Approval
description: Verify that restoration of archived data classified as Sensitive proceeds after SysAdmin approval is recorded.
pre_conditions: Restoration request 'REST-REQ-201' for Sensitive archive is submitted; SysAdmin 'sysadmin_01' reviews and records approval.
execution_steps: 1. User submits restoration request 'REST-REQ-201' for Sensitive archived data.
2. SysAdmin reviews request and submits approval.
3. BADMS verifies SysAdmin approval and triggers restoration procedure.
expected_outcome: Restoration begins execution; status updates to 'Restoring'/'Completed'; audit log records SysAdmin approval.
failure_guarantee: Restoration does not execute without recording verified SysAdmin approval in the audit trail.

title: Sensitive Restoration Blocked Without SysAdmin Approval
description: Verify that restoration of Sensitive archived data is blocked from proceeding if SysAdmin approval has not been granted.
pre_conditions: Restoration request 'REST-REQ-202' for Sensitive archive is submitted; SysAdmin approval has not been recorded (Pending/Rejected).
execution_steps: 1. Submit restoration request 'REST-REQ-202' for Sensitive data.
2. Attempt to trigger data recovery/restoration while approval is Pending or Rejected.
expected_outcome: Restoration execution is blocked; status remains 'Pending Approval' or 'Rejected'; no data is restored.
failure_guarantee: Sensitive data remains securely protected in archive storage; unauthorized disclosure is prevented.

title: Non-Sensitive Restoration Standard Path Permitted
description: Verify that restoration of data classified Routine or Archival follows the standard restoration path without requiring SysAdmin approval.
pre_conditions: Restoration request 'REST-REQ-203' submitted for data authoritatively classified as 'Routine'.
execution_steps: 2. Submit restoration request 'REST-REQ-203' for Routine dataset.
expected_outcome: Request proceeds directly along standard restoration path without routing for SysAdmin approval gate.
failure_guarantee: Non-Sensitive workflows are not inappropriately blocked by Sensitive-only approval requirements.

title: User-Specified Initial Classification Preserved
description: Verify that when a user provides an initial classification upon upload, BADMS preserves the provided classification.
pre_conditions: User 'user_01' is authenticated and has valid quota available.
execution_steps: 2. Submit secure archival request with initial_classification='Sensitive'.
expected_outcome: Request is created in 'Submitted' state; initial_classification field retains value 'Sensitive'.
failure_guarantee: User-supplied metadata is accurately preserved in request record.

title: Omitted Initial Classification Defaults to Routine
description: Verify that when a user omits the initial classification upon upload, BADMS automatically assigns 'Routine' as the default.
pre_conditions: User 'user_01' is authenticated and has storage quota available.
execution_steps: 2. Submit secure archival request leaving initial_classification field blank/omitted.
expected_outcome: Request is successfully submitted; initial_classification defaults to 'Routine'; routed to respective HoD.
failure_guarantee: Request does not fail validation due to missing classification; default assignment is deterministic.

title: AES-256 Encryption at Rest and Transit for Sensitive Data
description: Verify that data authoritatively classified as Sensitive is encrypted using AES-256 both at rest and in transit.
pre_conditions: Archive package 'ARCH-SENS-301' classified as Sensitive; IT Security configured encryption.
execution_steps: 2. Monitor transit channel encryption and storage write encryption.
3. Inspect archive metadata and stored ciphertext.
expected_outcome: Data is transmitted using TLS AES-256 and stored on disk with AES-256 encryption; encryption confirmation logged.
failure_guarantee: No plaintext copy of Sensitive data is persisted to disk or transmitted over unencrypted channels.

title: Archival of Sensitive Data Without AES-256 Prohibited
description: Verify that BADMS rejects any attempt to archive data classified Sensitive using non-AES-256 encryption or plaintext.
pre_conditions: Archive request classified Sensitive is being processed.
execution_steps: 1. Attempt to bypass AES-256 encryption by selecting an insecure cipher or plaintext storage.
expected_outcome: Archive operation is aborted; security exception raised; audit alert generated for non-compliant cipher configuration.
failure_guarantee: Sensitive data is never stored without AES-256 compliant encryption.

title: Non-Sensitive Data Bypasses Mandatory AES-256 Routing
description: Verify that data classified Routine or Archival does not require mandatory AES-256 IT Security routing.
pre_conditions: Secure archival request 'REQ-ARCH-111' authoritatively classified as 'Routine' by SysAdmin.
execution_steps: 3. Verify request proceeds to archive creation without routing to IT Security for encryption.
expected_outcome: Request proceeds directly to routine storage without requiring IT Security encryption configuration.
failure_guarantee: IT Security queue is not loaded with non-Sensitive routine archival requests.

title: Retention Policy Applied According to Authoritative Classification
description: Verify that data retention treatment is applied according to institute-defined policy associated with the authoritative classification.
pre_conditions: Dataset 'DS-ARCH-401' assigned authoritative classification 'Critical'.
execution_steps: 1. SysAdmin records authoritative classification 'Critical' on dataset.
expected_outcome: BADMS associates the institute retention rule for 'Critical' data with dataset 'DS-ARCH-401'.
failure_guarantee: Retention treatment cannot be dissociated from the authoritative classification of the data.

title: Retention Treatment Without Authoritative Classification Prohibited
description: Verify that BADMS rejects binding retention treatment or purging data when authoritative classification is missing.
pre_conditions: Data package 'DS-ARCH-402' has initial classification 'Routine' but authoritative classification is not yet assigned (null).
execution_steps: 1. Invoke retention binding service on dataset with null authoritative classification.
expected_outcome: Operation fails with error requiring authoritative classification before retention treatment binding.
failure_guarantee: Unclassified data is never subjected to arbitrary retention disposal or unverified policy rules.

title: Distinct Retention Treatment Selection Across Classifications
description: Verify that each distinct classification (Critical, Sensitive, Routine, Archival) maps to its respective institute retention rule.
pre_conditions: Four identical test records prepared for classification mapping.
execution_steps: 1. Assign each classification to respective datasets DS-1, DS-2, DS-3, DS-4.
2. Query resolved retention treatment for each dataset.
expected_outcome: Each dataset binds strictly to the institute retention treatment specified for its respective classification.
failure_guarantee: Cross-classification policy pollution is prevented; classification-to-retention binding is deterministic.

title: Storage-Extension Decided by Respective HoD Permitted
description: Verify that a storage-extension request is routed to and decided by the respective Department Head (HoD).
pre_conditions: Storage-extension request 'REQ-EXT-501' submitted by User in 'Civil Engineering'; usage validated; status is 'Pending HoD Review'.
expected_outcome: Decision is recorded; request status updates to 'Approved'; notification sent to requester; workflow completes.
failure_guarantee: Storage-extension decision is logged with HoD identity and cannot be altered post-decision.

title: Generic Admin or SysAdmin Approval of Storage-Extension Prohibited
description: Verify that a generic Admin or SysAdmin is prohibited from approving a storage-extension request.
pre_conditions: Storage-extension request 'REQ-EXT-502' in 'Pending HoD Review' state.
expected_outcome: Action is denied with 403 Forbidden; system enforces that only the respective HoD can approve storage extensions.
failure_guarantee: Request remains in 'Pending HoD Review' state; unauthorized administrative bypass is prevented.

title: Requester Self-Approval of Storage-Extension Prohibited
description: Verify that a user who submitted a storage-extension request cannot self-approve their own request.
pre_conditions: Storage-extension request 'REQ-EXT-503' submitted by user 'user_01'.
expected_outcome: Self-approval attempt is denied; non-HoD actor cannot decide storage-extension requests.
failure_guarantee: Request status remains pending; quota allocation cannot be self-expanded.

title: HoD Intra-Department Action and Report Access Permitted
description: Verify that an HoD can view operational reports and decide requests belonging to their own department.
pre_conditions: HoD 'hod_cs_01' belongs to 'Computer Science'; requests and reports exist for Computer Science department.
execution_steps: 2. Request departmental operational reports for 'Computer Science'.
3. Access pending Computer Science archival requests.
expected_outcome: Reports and pending requests for Computer Science are successfully displayed to HoD.
failure_guarantee: Departmental access grants do not leak data across administrative boundaries.

title: HoD Access to Foreign Department Reports Prohibited
description: Verify that an HoD is prohibited from accessing operational reports belonging to a different department.
pre_conditions: HoD 'hod_cs_01' belongs to 'Computer Science'; departmental reports exist for 'Electrical Engineering'.
expected_outcome: Access is denied with authorization error; report content is withheld.
failure_guarantee: Confidentiality of foreign departmental operational data is preserved.

title: HoD Decision on Foreign Department Storage Extension Prohibited
description: Verify that an HoD is prohibited from reviewing or deciding storage-extension requests from other departments.
pre_conditions: Storage-extension request 'REQ-EXT-504' submitted by Physics department user; HoD 'hod_cs_01' is Computer Science.
expected_outcome: Operation is denied with department scope mismatch error; request remains pending Physics HoD review.
failure_guarantee: Department scope isolation prevents unauthorized quota allocation across departments.

title: Valid Local Dataset Schedule Overrides Global Schedule Permitted
description: Verify that when a valid local backup schedule is defined for a dataset, BADMS executes according to the local schedule, overriding the global schedule.
pre_conditions: Global backup schedule set to Daily at 02:00 UTC; Dataset 'ds_grades' has valid local schedule configured for Daily at 22:00 UTC.
execution_steps: 2. Advance clock to 22:00 UTC and observe execution.
3. Advance clock to 02:00 UTC and observe execution.
expected_outcome: Backup triggers at 22:00 UTC following local schedule; does not trigger redundant backup at 02:00 UTC global time.
failure_guarantee: Dataset backup strictly obeys configured local schedule priority over global default.

title: Global Backup Schedule Applies When No Local Schedule Exists
description: Verify that where no local schedule exists for a dataset, the institution-wide global backup schedule applies automatically.
pre_conditions: Global backup schedule set to Daily at 03:00 UTC; Dataset 'ds_admissions' has no local schedule configured.
expected_outcome: Schedule resolution returns global schedule; automatic backup of 'ds_admissions' executes at 03:00 UTC.
failure_guarantee: Datasets without local schedules are never left unscheduled or unprotected.

title: Invalidated Local Schedule Fallback to Global Boundary
description: Verify that if a local schedule is removed or disabled, BADMS seamlessly falls back to the institution-wide global schedule.
pre_conditions: Dataset 'ds_library' had a local schedule; SysAdmin deletes local schedule; global schedule is Daily at 01:00 UTC.
expected_outcome: Local schedule reference is removed; effective schedule immediately switches to global default (01:00 UTC).
failure_guarantee: Transition between local and global schedule causes no gap in disaster recovery coverage.

title: Valid Backup Schedule Configuration Applied Permitted
description: Verify that a new or modified backup schedule with valid parameters and no conflicts is successfully validated and applied.
pre_conditions: SysAdmin user 'sysadmin_01' is authenticated; dataset 'ds_research' has no active schedule.
execution_steps: 1. SysAdmin submits new schedule with frequency='Weekly', time='01:00 UTC'.
2. BADMS validates parameters and checks for resource/time conflicts.
expected_outcome: Validation succeeds with no conflicts; schedule is saved and scheduled for execution; audit log records configuration.
failure_guarantee: If persistence fails, previous schedule state remains intact.

title: Invalid Schedule Parameters Rejected With Effective Schedule Preserved
description: Verify that submitting invalid schedule parameters (e.g. malformed cron, invalid time format) is rejected and existing effective schedule is preserved.
pre_conditions: Dataset 'ds_finance' has effective daily schedule at 23:00 UTC.
execution_steps: 1. Attempt to update schedule with invalid frequency and impossible time '25:70 UTC'.
expected_outcome: Validation fails with parameter error; update rejected; existing schedule (Daily at 23:00 UTC) remains in effect.
failure_guarantee: Invalid configuration is rejected prior to state change; effective schedule is never corrupted.

title: Conflicting Backup Schedule Configuration Rejected
description: Verify that a modified backup schedule that produces a direct timing/resource lock conflict on the same dataset is rejected.
pre_conditions: Dataset 'ds_core' already has an active local schedule at 04:00 UTC.
execution_steps: 1. Submit conflicting schedule targeting the same dataset and lock window.
expected_outcome: BADMS rejects the schedule modification due to conflict; existing active schedule remains unchanged.
failure_guarantee: Conflicting jobs cannot be scheduled concurrently on the same locked dataset.

title: Automatic Backup Succeeds When Repository Reachable Permitted
description: Verify that scheduled automatic backup executes successfully when the scheduled repository is online and reachable.
pre_conditions: Automatic backup due; destination storage repository 'repo_primary' status is 'Reachable' and verified.
execution_steps: 1. Scheduler initiates automatic backup at scheduled time.
3. Reachability confirmed; BADMS reads dataset and transfers to recovery storage.
expected_outcome: Backup completes successfully; data integrity verified; status recorded as 'Success'; timestamp logged.
failure_guarantee: Integrity verification confirms backup consistency upon transfer completion.

title: Automatic Backup Fails and Triggers Failure Handling When Repository Unreachable
description: Verify that when a scheduled repository is unreachable, automatic backup halts, status is marked Failure, and failure handling is triggered.
pre_conditions: Automatic backup due; repository 'repo_secondary' is unreachable (network timeout / connection refused).
execution_steps: 2. Reachability check fails with connection timeout.
3. System halts transfer and applies failure handling.
expected_outcome: Backup status recorded as 'Failure'; failure alert dispatched to SysAdmin; no partial or corrupt backup artifact marked valid.
failure_guarantee: Unreachable storage does not result in false 'Success' or corrupted recovery points.

title: Backup Failure Dispatches SysAdmin Alert Within SLA Permitted
description: Verify that when a backup fails, BADMS delivers an alert to the SysAdmin within the 5-minute SLA.
pre_conditions: Backup job 'BKP-FAIL-601' encounters an error and status transitions to 'Failure' at t0.
execution_steps: 2. Notification service queues and delivers failure alert to SysAdmin.
3. Measure elapsed time between failure event and alert delivery.
expected_outcome: Alert is delivered to SysAdmin at t <= t0 + 5 minutes (e.g. 10:01:30Z); alert contains backup ID, timestamp, and failure cause.
failure_guarantee: Alert queue guarantees notification delivery attempt upon failure state transition.

title: Backup Failure Alert SLA Threshold at Exactly 5 Minutes Boundary
description: Verify alert delivery compliance at the exact boundary threshold of 300 seconds (5 minutes) from failure occurrence.
pre_conditions: Backup job 'BKP-FAIL-602' marks Failure at t0 = 12:00:00Z.
execution_steps: 2. Simulate delivery at exact boundary timestamp 12:05:00Z (elapsed = 300s).
expected_outcome: Delivery at exactly 300s is evaluated as compliant with the 'within five minutes' SLA.
failure_guarantee: SLA calculation uses inclusive upper bound <= 300 seconds.

title: Backup Failure Alert Exceeding 5 Minutes SLA Breach Prohibited
description: Verify that an alert delivered after more than 5 minutes (301+ seconds) is flagged as an SLA violation.
pre_conditions: Backup job 'BKP-FAIL-603' failed at 14:00:00Z; alert delivery delayed until 14:05:01Z (301 seconds).
expected_outcome: System records SLA breach for notification delivery exceeding 5 minutes; compliance metric updated.
failure_guarantee: SLA monitoring logs late delivery event for audit review.

title: Consecutive Failures Count 1 and 2 Do Not Escalate Boundary
description: Verify that after 1 and 2 consecutive backup failures, SysAdmin is alerted but NO escalation notification is sent to the Director of IT.
pre_conditions: Backup history has 0 consecutive failures.
execution_steps: 1. Trigger 1st backup failure; verify SysAdmin alert dispatched and check Director of IT notification queue.
2. Trigger 2nd consecutive backup failure; verify SysAdmin alert dispatched and check Director of IT notification queue.
expected_outcome: SysAdmin receives failure alerts; Director of IT receives 0 notifications; consecutive_failures counter equals 2.
failure_guarantee: Director of IT notification is strictly suppressed when consecutive failure count is below 3.

title: Exactly Three Consecutive Backup Failures Triggers Escalation Boundary
description: Verify that upon occurrence of exactly the third consecutive backup failure, BADMS escalates the condition to the Director of IT.
pre_conditions: Backup history has exactly 2 consecutive failures.
execution_steps: 3. System increments counter to 3 and evaluates escalation threshold.
expected_outcome: Escalation notification is generated and dispatched to Director of IT; SysAdmin also alerted; escalation logged in audit trail.
failure_guarantee: Escalation to Director of IT is guaranteed upon reaching the threshold of 3 consecutive failures.

title: Successful Backup Resets Consecutive Failure Counter Boundary
description: Verify that an intervening successful backup resets the consecutive failure counter to zero, preventing premature escalation.
pre_conditions: System has recorded 2 consecutive backup failures.
execution_steps: 2. Next scheduled backup completes with status 'Success'.
5. Check if Director of IT is notified.
expected_outcome: Success resets consecutive failure counter to 0; Failure_3 sets counter to 1; NO escalation notification is sent to Director of IT.
failure_guarantee: Counter strictly counts *consecutive* failures; non-consecutive failures do not cause escalation.

title: Subsequent Failure Beyond Three Maintains Escalation Permitted
description: Verify system behavior when a 4th consecutive failure occurs without recovery, confirming ongoing escalation state.
pre_conditions: Consecutive failure counter is at 3; initial escalation notification already sent.
expected_outcome: Consecutive failure counter increments to 4; Director of IT escalation status remains active / re-notified according to policy; SysAdmin alerted.
failure_guarantee: Counter does not overflow or reset until an explicit Success backup occurs.

title: Storage-Extension Request Validated When Quota Full Permitted
description: Verify that a storage-extension request is validated and routed to HoD when the user's quota is full (100% usage).
pre_conditions: User 'user_01' allocated 100 GB; current usage is 100 GB (100% full quota).
execution_steps: 1. User submits storage-extension request for 50 GB.
2. BADMS validates current storage usage against allocated quota.
expected_outcome: Request passes validation; request status set to 'Submitted' / 'Pending HoD Review'; routed to requester's HoD.
failure_guarantee: Valid extension requests from users with full quotas are properly forwarded to HoD for decision.

title: Storage-Extension Request Rejected When Quota Not Full Prohibited
description: Verify that a storage-extension request is rejected/flagged as invalid when the user's storage quota is not full.
pre_conditions: User 'user_02' allocated 100 GB; current usage is 45 GB (quota is not full).
execution_steps: 2. BADMS checks current usage against allocated quota.
3. System detects quota is not full.
expected_outcome: Request is rejected at validation; error returned informing user quota must be full; request is NOT routed to HoD; state unchanged.
failure_guarantee: Premature storage-extension requests do not alter request state or burden HoD review.

title: Storage-Extension Usage Threshold Boundary Testing
description: Verify storage usage validation at the boundary: usage just below 100% (99.9%) rejected vs exactly 100% accepted.
pre_conditions: User has 100.0 GB quota allocation.
execution_steps: 1. Test with usage at 99.9 GB: submit extension request, observe validation rejection.
2. Increase usage to exactly 100.0 GB: submit extension request, observe validation acceptance.
expected_outcome: 99.9 GB usage is rejected (quota not full); exactly 100.0 GB usage passes validation and routes to HoD.
failure_guarantee: Storage-extension validation enforces strict boundary check before accepting submission.

title: HoD Storage-Extension Decision Informed by Criteria Permitted
description: Verify that HoD reviews available storage infrastructure, departmental policies, and user justification to decide a storage-extension request.
pre_conditions: Valid storage-extension request pending; system presents available infrastructure info, departmental policy limits, and user justification.
execution_steps: 1. HoD accesses request review screen displaying infrastructure availability, departmental policy, and justification.
2. HoD reviews details and submits approval.
expected_outcome: Decision is recorded as 'Approved'; requester is notified; workflow completes without post-approval S-POST requirement.
failure_guarantee: Recorded decision permanently stores references to the review criteria presented at decision time.

title: HoD Storage-Extension Decision Without Stated Criteria Prohibited
description: Verify that BADMS blocks recorded decision if required review criteria (e.g. user justification or infrastructure verification) are missing/unvalidated.
pre_conditions: Extension request submitted with missing justification or corrupted infrastructure metrics.
execution_steps: 1. HoD attempts to record decision on request lacking mandatory justification and infrastructure context.
expected_outcome: Decision submission is blocked with validation error requiring all review criteria to be present.
failure_guarantee: Arbitrary extension decisions without complete context cannot be recorded in BADMS.

title: Requested Storage Exceeding Available Infrastructure Detected Boundary
description: Verify that when requested storage extension exceeds available infrastructure capacity, BADMS detects and flags the shortfall during review.
pre_conditions: Available infrastructure storage is 100 GB; user requests 200 GB extension.
execution_steps: 2. BADMS computes requested storage against available infrastructure.
expected_outcome: BADMS flags that requested storage (200 GB) exceeds available infrastructure (100 GB); surfaces notification to HoD; records decision as informed without requiring automated shortfall remediation.
failure_guarantee: System guarantees detection and visibility of capacity shortfalls to decision-maker.

title: Super Admin Offline-Initiated Special Archival Permitted
description: Verify that Super Admin alone is permitted to perform a special archival operation in BADMS following an offline request from an authority.
pre_conditions: Super Admin 'superadmin_01' received an offline special archival request from Dean of Research for extended storage of Sensitive research data.
execution_steps: 3. Enter dataset details and execute special archival operation.
expected_outcome: Operation is permitted and successfully executed; BADMS records operation outcome and audit entry; no online HoD approval required.
failure_guarantee: Special archival operation outcome is permanently recorded with Super Admin attribution.

title: SysAdmin Special Archival Operation Prohibited
description: Verify that a SysAdmin is prohibited from performing the special archival operation within BADMS.
pre_conditions: SysAdmin 'sysadmin_01' is authenticated.
execution_steps: 2. Attempt to invoke special archival operation.
expected_outcome: Operation is denied with 403 Forbidden; special archival restricted exclusively to Super Admin role.
failure_guarantee: Special archival privilege cannot be exercised by regular administrative roles.

title: Regular User or HoD Special Archival Operation Prohibited
description: Verify that a regular User or HoD is prohibited from performing or initiating online special archival operations in BADMS.
pre_conditions: User 'user_faculty_01' is authenticated.
execution_steps: 2. Attempt to trigger special archival endpoint.
expected_outcome: Access denied; no online submission workflow exists for special archival in BADMS (offline request to Super Admin only).
failure_guarantee: Offline-originator scope discipline is preserved; online endpoint access denied.

title: Super Admin Global Backup Policy Configuration Permitted
description: Verify that Super Admin holds highest authority to define and modify institution-wide global backup schedules and default policies.
pre_conditions: Super Admin 'superadmin_01' is authenticated.
execution_steps: 2. Submit new institution-wide global backup schedule and default policy.
expected_outcome: Configuration accepted and applied globally; audit log records global policy change under Super Admin.
failure_guarantee: Institution-wide default configuration remains intact if update transaction fails.

title: SysAdmin Global Backup Schedule Configuration Prohibited
description: Verify that a SysAdmin is prohibited from modifying institution-wide global backup schedules or default backup policies.
pre_conditions: SysAdmin 'sysadmin_01' is authenticated.
